status: WRITTEN exact compact global-maximum formulation of the unpaid interior contraction, UNREVIEWED; no additional physical candidate
finding: Normalize the block-upper traceless source x=(Ad,Bd), y=(E,F) by ||x||²+||y||²=1, and vary rank-two P over its compact Grassmannian. If ANY original T2 failure exists, the continuous objective m=Tr(PX†X) attains a maximum m=2+δ>2, with P a top-two spectral projector of X†X and (x,y) a top eigenvector of the 22×22 source Gram. The source equations are Jy=(D+δI)x, J†x=(N+δI)y, so x,y,J are nonzero and x†Jy=x†(D+δI)x=y†(N+δI)y>0. Conversely ANY admissible δ>0 solution of these two eigen-equations at any P would already give an original T2 counterexample; no such solution is claimed.
equivalent_fixed_point: Let π_up be the Frobenius projection onto tracezero local 2+2 block-upper matrices. Since J,D,N are partial-trace adjoints, the source eigen-equations are equivalently π_up Tr_B(XP)=(2+δ)A and π_up Tr_A(XP)=(2+δ)B, with P top2 of X†X at a global maximizer. One may instead optimize the original unrestricted traceless source and use the full tracezero projection π0; unitary Schur then recovers a block-upper representative. All variables remain universally quantified.
limitations: This regularizes the singular denominators via δ>0 but does NOT rule out such δ, establish the contraction or imply a counterexample. No selected q/numeric control, computation, novelty or physical conclusion.
